title: Service Contracts: Renewal Offers on a Contracted Lane
content:
When an AHL Service Contract on a lane is active and nearing the end of its term, the line may offer the customer a renewal on that same lane. This page governs the earliest date for such an offer and the tier level at which the renewal may be made.

## Clauses

1. **Earliest issue date.** A renewal offer on a lane whose contract is active cannot be issued before the date that lies the renewal notice period, in calendar days, ahead of the current contract's expiry date. The notice period is that of the tier the current contract holds.
2. **Performance test.** The renewal may be written at the current tier or at a higher one only if, by the offer date, the current contract has lifted a volume at least equal to the tier's performance percentage of its commitment. Lifted volume here is the volume credited to the current contract, net of any reversals.
3. **Outcome when the test is not met.** A contract that falls short of the percentage is renewed one tier below its current tier, or at the lowest tier whose commitment band holds the new commitment.

## Figures by tier of the current contract

| Tier of the current contract | Notice period (calendar days ahead of expiry) | Lifted share of commitment needed (percent) |
|---|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | 60 | 80 |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | 60 | 80 |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | 90 | 85 |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | 90 | 85 |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | 120 | 90 |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | 120 | 90 |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Key Account contract expires on 30 September. Counting 90 calendar days back gives 2 July, the first date on which a renewal offer may be issued; an offer dated 1 July is premature.
- A Regional Account contract carries a commitment of 400 FEU. With 340 FEU lifted by the offer date it has reached 85 percent, so a same-tier or higher-tier renewal is open to it. With 339.9 FEU it has not, and clause 3 applies.
- A Global Account contract of 2000 FEU needs 1800 FEU lifted by the offer date (90 percent) to keep a same-tier or higher-tier renewal open.

## Points of judgement

**Does meeting the percentage entitle the customer to a higher tier?** No. The percentage is a condition that must hold for the same or a higher tier to be offered; it is not a promise of either.

**Whose figures apply — the current tier's or the proposed tier's?** Both the notice period and the performance percentage are read from the tier of the contract being renewed.
